tiers_note: T40 as given in BRIEF_CHECKS = DF2|M2|b1|v1|s0.3|L1.5|K2|RB (original gate). results/select_df2_fixed.json (audit-fixed gate, written after the brief) adopts v1|s0.3|L1.0|K2|RB in tier C instead; tested here as T40alt.

final_verdicts.T25: CAGR-PLATEAU / TIER-EDGE: own CAGR flat (16/17 one-at-a-time neighbours within 1pp, joint median 8.96 vs 8.97) but WD sits on the favourable edge (10/17 core and 34/100 joint neighbours keep WD>=-25%; joint WD median -25.74). Whole-set reselection: the -25% tier is EMPTY in 3/17 off-grid environments and its winner drops to 2.55-7.89% in 4 more.
final_verdicts.T30: CAGR-PLATEAU / TIER-EDGE (knife-edge WD): own CAGR flat (16/17 within 1pp) but WD -29.97 vs budget -30 -> only 7/17 core and 17/100 joint neighbours stay inside; joint WD median -31.48. Reselection: tier winner identity flips in 12-13/17 environments, tier winner CAGR 9.10-11.62 (median 10.27-10.35), so the tier-level number is ~stable while the pick identity is not.
final_verdicts.T40: Config itself: mostly plateau (14/17 core in tier, 15/17 within 1pp; joint 38% in tier, joint path median 12.95). ADOPTION is a SPIKE: DF2 bond-excess-0 gate margin vs v1|s0.3|L1.0|K2|RB is +0.02pp (original gate) / -0.27pp (audit-fixed gate); under 17 off-grid environments the original-gate rule keeps this config in only 2/17 and the tier-C adopted CAGR median is 11.51% (audit-fixed gate: 11.42%) instead of 13.24%.
final_verdicts.T40alt: PLATEAU: v1|s0.3|L1.0|K2|RB (tier-C adopted under the audit-fixed gate) keeps 16/17 core and 92/100 joint neighbours in tier, all 17 core within 1pp (10.81-11.58); adopted in 13/17 environments under the fixed gate.
